messages:
Noah (partnerships): OptiCore wants a tight "thermal stability" + perf/W story for their P53 board. They want a small public table (tokens/s, W, energy/token) and a short methods appendix. Can we scope a 2.5-week cadence? @Iris @Tanner @Mina thoughts? Vik: what telemetry/units can you provide?

Vik (OptiCore): We can put 3 P53 units in our Austin lab, firmware v5.7, provide PDUs and a /metrics agent for chip and board power. We can also enable an experimental kernel path p53-fastgemm in firmware v5.8 but that one is "preview". Embargo: mid-September preferred.

Iris (eng-runtime): Minimal credible matrix: 3 models (redwood-open-7b, mixtral-13b, 65b), quant modes int8 + int4, batch sizes 1/8/16. Kernels compared: stock, p53-fastgemm (preview) and flash-attn-v3. Include a sustained 10-min run to report "sustained" tokens/s and power.

Tanner (eng-ml): We'll run deterministic prompt pack and compute delta-perplexity and delta-ROUGE. For the public table show int4 numbers but include an accuracy footnote and calibration steps. Gate: if int4 perplexity >3% worse than int8, mark it in table.

Mina (eng-infra): Telemetry: 1s PDU sampling, chip-level power at 500ms if possible, ambient rack temp, inlet/outlet temps. Tag runs with run_id, firmware_rev, kernel_variant. Ingestion target: s3://redwood-benching/opticore/p53/{run_id}/telemetry.jsonl. Alert if power variance >12% across repeats. Also require NTP sync across hosts.

Vik (OptiCore): We can provide power at 500ms and inlet temps. Firmware 5.7 on lab units; 5.8 preview can be tested but not quoted in press. We'll provide ACL and prof tool `p53-prof`.

Noah (partnerships): Proposed schedule: week 1 dry-run (7b small matrix), week 2 full sweep, week 3 validation + docs + legal + marketing. Mid-September embargo target. Owners? Iris runbook, Tanner evals, Mina telemetry, Vik hardware + ACL, Clara draft comms.

Iris (eng-runtime): I'll draft the runbook and kernel matrix. Example run command:
```
./run_bench --model mixtral-13b --quant int8 --kernel p53-fastgemm --batch 8 \
  --duration 600 --out s3://redwood-benching/opticore/p53/{run_ts}/ \
  --tags run_id=optip53-1972501234,firmware=5.7
```
Will include pre/post `p53-prof` snapshots and a `--sustained` flag for 10-min captures.

Tanner (eng-ml): I'll publish the prompt pack and evaluation script in bench/evals/opticore and add the quality gate: int4 perplexity delta >3% -> footnote. Also add deterministic seeds.

Mina (eng-infra): I'll create the ingestion bucket and set alerts: missing telemetry >8% -> fail run; power var >12% -> flag. I'll also capture ambient temp and include it in the appendix.

Bench Bot: bench-run queued: id=optip53-1972501234, owner=iris, matrix=3models x {int8,int4} x 3batch-sizes, sustained=10m for selected runs.

Vik (OptiCore): ACL and `p53-prof` binary uploaded to secure share. Units available Mon (1972587600). We'll provide remote access for Redwood engineers.

Clara (marketing): I'll draft an embargoed blog outline and visuals: throughput vs watt line, energy/token table, and a short methods appendix listing kernel flags and telemetry approach. Legal: please review partner embargo template.

Noah (partnerships): Action items recap: Iris runbook + kernel matrix, Tanner eval pack, Mina telemetry + alerts, Vik hardware + ACL, Clara draft PR + coordinate legal. Quick Q: comfortable publishing p53-fastgemm preview numbers if labeled "tech preview"? Iris/Tanner?

Iris (eng-runtime): We can include preview as a "tech preview" row but only quote the stable firmware 5.7 numbers in the headline. Preview rows in appendix fine.

Tanner (eng-ml): Agreed. Headline uses 5.7 runs only. Preview in appendix with explicit label and quality notes.

Mina (eng-infra): Also, capture wall-voltage and PDU serials in metadata to help reproducibility.

Vik (OptiCore): Noted. We'll add PDU serials and provide pump/offboard cooling telemetry if relevant.

Noah (partnerships): Great. Next sync after dry-run artifacts. Thanks all :thumbsup: — closing thread for now; post updates here.
